Need permission. Changes summary:

- `fallback` → render prop `(error, reset) => ReactNode` so custom UI can call retry
- `onError` prop for external logging (Sentry, etc.)
- Structured `console.error` object instead of positional args
- `componentStack` shown in collapsible `<details>` in default UI

Once permitted, will write the file. Approve and I'll proceed.
